decision: Source/value NO-GO before new protein quantities.
independent_reason: The actual CAM secretome protocol is not native EMC: WEHI-164 is mouse fibrosarcoma and U2OS human osteosarcoma. Its four reporter derivatives do not create additional native patients. The distinct matched patient-model MS source has positive source-level measurement potential, but individual EMC disease, model-origin, assay-condition/control and public release fields remain unknown.
source_validity: 41-plex conditioned-medium and equivalently prepared cell-free control methods are real measurements; their eligibility fails for this native EMC question only. They do not establish native EMC secretion, vessels, oxygen, functional dependence or a human EMC protein profile. Matched-model MS could support a limited useful protein comparison if actual disease/condition/control maps existed.
prior_art_limit: The matched-source published title/abstract-level global model-fidelity claim is prior art. It does not prove every possible EMC-specific comparison is already answered or intrinsically worthless. Current NO-GO rests on missing native/source inputs and an unestablished consequential EMC-specific use, not a universal pairing/protein requirement or an assumption that global fidelity excludes all new disease evidence.
coverage: Two specified non-EMC parent lines and all four derived conditions retained. Every possible EMC condition in the matched MS source remains pending, not absent; genuine DOI403/noOA metadata do not rule out every public supplement or repository. Prior PanAtlas/ProCan/CPTAC and other whole-proteome/phosphoproteome/model/spatial/ADC dispositions remain at their verified scope. Partial100/171 and100/123 catalogues are source selection, not body evaluations.
strongest_alternatives: Species and stromal mixture in tumor/model comparisons
Culture/selection/adaptation and capture/handling rather than native disease state
Already published global model similarity rather than a new experimental-model decision
specific_reopening: Actual primary-linked public all-EMC model/tissue/condition/protein-input and species/control maps, followed by a useful fixed EMC-specific design decision beyond the prior global claim. Same-donor pairing is required only for a donor-retention estimand; a justified population comparison may use other explicit controls.
review_scope: One independent before-values source/prior-art/usefulness challenge of the exact frozen compact gate. No new primary retrieval, outcome access, cutoff, statistic, hypothesis or whole-paper review.
no_universal_veto: A limited empirical RNA, protein, imaging or metabolite comparison may be useful without universal protein validation or same-donor pairing. Required controls depend on the actual estimand.
promotion: NO. Suitable public evidence and identity/control/assay gaps remain pending; source eligibility itself is not a publication-worthy finding.
campaign: Goal unmet; search not exhausted; existing GPNMB candidate remains held and TMEM266 shelved.
